2K FHD clarity shows you exactly who is at your door, even at night, and the 16:9 expanded view covers the whole entrance area.
When someone rings, a video call pops up on your phone. If you are away, quick responses and voice memos make sure you never miss a visitor.
The built-in 5000mAh battery lets you mount the doorbell wherever you like without any wiring.
Recordings are saved on a microSD card of up to 128 GB, so your footage stays private and no subscription is needed.
Works with eufy and Voice Assistants
Pairs with the eufy HomeBase S380 and the eufy Minibase Chime (T8023), and works with Alexa and Google Assistant devices.
